title: Tesla invests about $2B in xAI

sources.quote: On January 16, 2026, Tesla entered into an agreement to invest approximately $2 billion to acquire shares of Series E Preferred Stock of xAI as part of their recent publicly-disclosed financing round.
In January 2026, Tesla entered into an agreement with xAI to invest $2,000 million via a purchase of xAI Series E Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock.

explain: Tesla agreed to put about $2 billion into Elon Musk's AI company xAI in its Series E round. After SpaceX bought xAI, Tesla's stake was converted into SpaceX shares.
